description: Defines constants, enums, classes, and structures related to 5G NR SSB (Synchronization Signal Block) configuration, including bitmaps, identifiers, and parameters as per 3GPP TS specifications.

classes.name: ssb_bitmap_t
classes.description: Implements a bitset for SSB positions within a burst, with methods to set and get bitmap and L_max.

methods.name: set_bitmap
methods.description: Sets the bitmap with a specified L_max, shifting bits accordingly.

methods.name: get_L_max
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of bits (L_max) in the bitmap.

methods.name: set_L_max
methods.description: Sets the L_max after bitmap construction and resizes the bitset.
